basis: Conservative v1.1 interpretation of the immutable 18-record approved seed corpus. Candidate mappings must not be treated as author terminology, approved claims, or product validation.
principles: Application family is a broad use-case lens, not efficacy or product validation.
Targets are mapped only where the seed record explicitly supports the intervention focus.
Mechanisms are proposed only for records whose approved rapid review explicitly describes a mechanism relationship.
Candidate mappings do not overwrite human-reviewed mappings or extraction states.

application_families.rationale: Episodic-specificity memory training in healthy older adults.
Healthy older-adult cognitive training with memory and problem-solving outcomes.

targets.rationale: The approved route rationale explicitly describes repeated episodic-specificity reconstruction developing retrieval/specificity.

application_families.rationale: Educational training in children with learning difficulties.
Protocol explicitly targets working memory, inhibitory control and cognitive flexibility.
Kindergarten numerical-knowledge and working-memory intervention.
Working-memory training is one intervention component.

targets.rationale: The intervention explicitly contains working-memory training.
The intervention explicitly contains domain-specific numerical-knowledge learning.

application_families.rationale: Experimental relational and analogical learning.
Analogy and relational reasoning performance are the transfer outcomes.

targets.rationale: Multi-exemplar relational training explicitly develops relational responding and analogical transfer.

application_families.rationale: The intervention is explicitly multi-operation executive-function training.
Cognitive training in healthy younger and older adults.
Older-adult subgroup and three-month retention are relevant to maintenance across ageing.

targets.rationale: Approved route rationale describes training multiple executive operations; outcomes include working memory, inhibition and flexibility.

application_families.rationale: Twelve-week combined physical and cognitive intervention in cognitively normal older adults.
General cognitive-function development in healthy older adults.
Executive function is among the explicitly trained cognitive domains.

targets.rationale: The approved route rationale treats Baduanjin as changing the longer-term physiological/behavioural operating substrate without specifying a narrower physiological mediator.
Protocol explicitly targets memory, attention, language, executive function and visuospatial cognition.

application_families.rationale: Systematic review/meta-analysis of working-memory cognitive training plus tDCS.
Healthy-adult cognitive training evidence.

components.component_name: active tDCS plus structured cognitive training

targets.rationale: The synthesis explicitly evaluates working-memory outcomes from structured cognitive training plus tDCS; the seed record does not justify a narrower physiological target.

application_families.rationale: Measurement review of working-memory tasks and transfer measures.
Reviewed evidence concerns healthy older adults.
Mechanistic evidence on learned abstract relational structure and consolidation.

mechanisms.support_summary: A stimulus-independent relational representation emerged over days after learning two graphs with shared structure.
mechanisms.rationale: The approved seed review explicitly identifies emergence of an abstract relational representation over days as mechanistic evidence.

application_families.rationale: Perceptual-learning generalisation evidence.
Generalisation of perceptual discrimination performance across locations.

mechanisms.support_summary: Longer temporal integration/serial dependence was associated with greater generalisation across visual locations.
mechanisms.rationale: The approved review describes serial dependence/temporal integration as predicting generalisation.

application_families.rationale: Retrieval-practice learning and metamemory mechanism evidence.

mechanisms.support_summary: Confidence moderated how retrieval errors predicted subsequent learning and network engagement.
mechanisms.rationale: The approved review explicitly describes confidence as gating error-driven learning and metamemory-network engagement.

application_families.rationale: Acute stress changes the operating state in which prediction and episodic encoding compete.
Stress-state evidence is relevant to sustainable cognitive-affective functioning, without implying a wellbeing intervention effect.

mechanisms.support_summary: Acute stress shifted representation toward statistical prediction and away from episodic encoding.
mechanisms.rationale: This relationship is explicitly stated in the approved mechanism review.

application_families.rationale: Controlled experiments on metacognitive prompts during educationally relevant learning.
Large school field experiment on AI tutoring and mastery-based mathematics practice.

targets.rationale: AI support changes instructional feedback and error handling in the learning activity system.
The intervention directly manipulates the progression rule governing advancement through practice.

application_families.rationale: Eight-week classroom study examining supported versus independent writing and higher-order thinking.
Authentic writing quality and argument/revision quality are performance outcomes.

targets.rationale: Bounded versus open AI changes how cognitive work is distributed between learner and AI.
The bounded-AI condition includes compulsory reflection as an explicit strategy overlay.

application_families.rationale: Human-AI assistance experiment on completion time, expected speed and effort across cognitive work tasks.

targets.rationale: AI-assisted versus independent completion changes allocation of task work between human and AI.

application_families.rationale: Experiment manipulates where AI support enters a writing workflow and measures ownership and quality.

targets.rationale: Moving AI support among planning, drafting and revision directly manipulates human-AI role allocation across workflow stages.

application_families.rationale: Observational evidence concerns AI offloading, cognitive agency and downstream functioning in students and knowledge workers.
Deep processing, autonomous capability and student use make learning a relevant secondary lens.
